title: Same SKU, different stock
persona: Phone-case brand: the same case is listed for two phone models under one SKU, and the counts drift apart.
opening: Some of my listings share one SKU, but Shopify shows different stock on each. Flag the ones that don't match.

facts.what a mismatch is: two or more listings with the same SKU and different stock

success: the listings whose shared SKU shows different stock are flagged
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a rule that writes a value into every row
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
